root.name: ニューロクライン・バイオサイエンシズ

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: うつ病薬候補オサバンパトールなど精神科化合物を武田から導入
relations.text_en: In-licensed osavampator and other psychiatry compounds from Takeda

source.label: Neurocrine 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Osavampator was in-licensed from Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited (Takeda) in 2020, and we have exclusive worldwide rights to develop and commercialize osavampator, except in Japan, where Takeda has exclusive development and commercialization rights.

relations.text: 統合失調症薬候補ディレクリジンをネクセラから導入
relations.text_en: In-licensed the schizophrenia candidate direclidine from Nxera

source.label: Neurocrine 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Direclidine was in-licensed from Nxera Pharma UK Limited (Nxera) in 2021, and we retain global rights.

relations.text: CAH治療薬クレネシティの成分をサノフィから取得
relations.text_en: Acquired global rights to CRF-1 antagonists, including crinecerfont, from Sanofi

source.label: Neurocrine 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In 2014, we entered into a license agreement with Sanofi, pursuant to which we acquired the global rights to develop and commercialize certain corticotropin-releasing factor type 1 (CRF-1) receptor antagonists, including crinecerfont.

companies.name: ゼノン・ファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: てんかん治療で提携し、候補薬NBI-921355を導入
relations.text_en: Epilepsy collaboration; NBI-921355 was in-licensed from Xenon

source.label: Xenon 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our Partnered Program with Neurocrine Biosciences In December 2019, we entered into a license and collaboration agreement with Neurocrine Biosciences to develop treatments for epilepsy.

companies.name: メイズ・セラピューティクス

relations.text: ATXN2を狙う研究プログラムを独占ライセンス
relations.text_en: Granted Neurocrine an exclusive worldwide license to its ATXN2 research program

source.label: Maze Therapeutics 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In May 2024, the Company entered into an exclusive license agreement with Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc., or Neurocrine, pursuant to which the Company granted Neurocrine an exclusive worldwide license to a discovery research program targeting ATXN2

relations.text: 子宮内膜症薬エラゴリクスをアッヴィが製造・販売し、ロイヤルティを受け取る
relations.text_en: AbbVie makes and sells elagolix; Neurocrine earns royalties

source.label: Neurocrine 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, we depend on AbbVie for the manufacture and commercialization of ORILISSA and ORIAHNN and for the continued development of elagolix.

relations.text: 日本などアジアでバルベナジンを販売(旧・田辺三菱製薬)
relations.text_en: Markets valbenazine in Japan and other Asian markets

source.label: Neurocrine 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: INGREZZA is marketed as DYSVAL ® (valbenazine) in Japan and REMLEAS ® (valbenazine) in other select Asian markets, where Tanabe Pharma Corporation (formerly Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma Corporation) retains commercialization rights.

companies.name: ボイジャー・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 遺伝子治療で提携、ニューロクラインは2023年に出資
relations.text_en: Gene therapy collaboration; Neurocrine made an equity investment in 2023

source.label: Voyager 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We have entered into agreements with collaboration partners and licensees including Neurocrine, Novartis, and Alexion to provide access our TRACER Capsids for the development and commercialization of AAV gene therapy candidates in specified indications.

companies.name: ソレノ・セラピューティクス

relations.text: 2026年4月、ニューロクラインによる買収契約を締結
relations.text_en: Agreed in April 2026 to be acquired by Neurocrine

source.label: Soleno 10-K/A(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 5, 2026, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the Merger Agreement) with Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc.

relations.text: 遅発性ジスキネジア薬INGREZZAはテバのAUSTEDOと競合

source.label: Neurocrine 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: INGREZZA competes with AUSTEDO (deutetrabenazine), marketed by Teva Pharmaceuticals Industries, for the treatment of TD in adults and chorea associated with Huntington's disease.

companies.name: LBファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: 統合失調症薬の開発競合にニューロクラインを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Neurocrine among companies developing schizophrenia treatments

source.label: LB Pharmaceuticals 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We are also aware of several companies developing compounds for the treatment of schizophrenia, including Alto Neuroscience Inc., Minerva Neurosciences, Inc., MapLight Therapeutics, Inc., Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc.

relations.text: うつ病分野の競合にニューロクラインを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Neurocrine among competitors in depression

source.label: AtaiBeckley 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We face competition across our programs in depression, including from Axsome Therapeutics, GH Research, The Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies of Johnson & Johnson, Helus Pharma, Neumora Therapeutics, Alto Neuroscience, Neurocrine Biosciences

companies.name: ラリマー・セラピューティクス
companies.sub: フリードライヒ失調症

relations.text: フリードライヒ失調症の開発競合にニューロクライン/ボイジャーを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Neurocrine/Voyager among other developers of Friedreich's ataxia treatments

source.label: Larimar 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Other competitors currently developing therapeutics to treat FA include, but are not limited to Design Therapeutics, Lexeo Therapeutics, Neurocrine Biosciences/Voyager Therapeutics and PTC Therapeutics ("PTC").

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
